title: Ollama runner errors
description: The Ollama runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point. Each refuses run/start, so no run starts.

oneOf.description: The run/start options hold a key the runner doesn't define.
An option's value has the wrong shape, or contextLength is above the model's maximum. The fix names what is valid.
run/start names no runtime, so the runner has no service to talk to. The fix says to name one for the actor.

The runtime's endpoint has a path, or a port or host name no connection could use. Ollama's own API is at the endpoint's root. The fix names the runtime's config path and its TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_ENDPOINT variable.
The runtime has a credential, which the Ollama runner never sends. Its value isn't read, and isn't in the error.
Ollama didn't answer at the endpoint in time, or answered with something that isn't Ollama's version.
Ollama has no model of that name: it isn't pulled. The fix names ollama pull.
Ollama doesn't list the tools capability for the model, or doesn't say what the model can do, so the runner can't give it troupe's tools.

capabilities.description: The capabilities Ollama listed. Absent: Ollama listed none.

where.description: Where the problem is, such as options.maxTurns or runtime.endpoint.

model.description: The model, as the run's runtime named it.
